answer: A farm emitting 28 variations of one paragraph hence burns for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the ember panel. Because the entropy is measured at the forge gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the orchard audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 3 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 21 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
